summary.text: Eric Dinowitz represents the Northwest Bronx on the New York City Council, in a district that includes Kingsbridge, Riverdale, Norwood and Bedford Park.
His Council biography describes him as a former public school special education teacher who now chairs the Committee on Education.

paragraphs.text: Dinowitz is a lifelong Northwest Bronx resident who grew up in Mitchell-Lama housing, according to his Council biography.
Before his election he taught special education in public schools for over a decade, was a Chapter Leader for the United Federation of Teachers, and was Aging Chair of Bronx Community Board 8.
He formerly chaired the Committee on Higher Education and also chairs the Jewish Caucus, the biography says, and he passed legislation to streamline the SCRIE application process for tenants.
